text: Pellet, wi'uɓe ɓen: Joomi amen ko Allah, wanaa goɗɗum goo, hooti ɓe tabiti e ɗum, ɓe woɗɗitii haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin; Malaa'ika'en hino jippoo e maɓɓe tuma ɓe ƴettitetee, ɓe wi'ana ɓe: wata on hulu maayde e ko hikkori yeeso mayre, wata on sunano ko acciɗon aduna; wewliree Aljanna mo wonanoɗon e fodeede on aduna, sabu ko gomɗinirɗon kon Allah, golluɗon ko moƴƴi.
